basic_details.job_title: NITT Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Project Associate I Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at the National Institute of Technology, Tiruchirappalli (NITT) has invited Indian nationals to apply for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) / Project Associate-I (PA-I) position in the ISRO-RESPOND funded project on AI-enabled data association and intelligent radar scheduling. The tenure is 2 years, with JRF pay of 37,000 + 20% HRA and PA-I pay of 31000 + 20% HRA. Applications in the prescribed format must be emailed to [email protected] with the subject "JRF - ISRO-RESPOND Programme" by 30.11.2026 at 5 P.M.

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates by email

age_limit.details: The age of the applicant should be less than 35 years as on the closing date of application. Candidates belonging to OBC and SC / ST are eligible for normal relaxation of 3 and 5 years respectively.

vacancy_details.Pay: JRF: 37,000+20% HRA (two years), valid GATE/NET score; PA-I: 31000+20% HRA (Two years), no GATE/NET score

post_wise_breakdown.pay: JRF: 37,000+20% HRA (two years), valid GATE/NET score; PA-I: 31000+20% HRA (Two years), no GATE/NET score

how_to_apply: Applications are sent by email, not by post. The application must be in the prescribed format printed with the advertisement, and no other format is accepted.
Fill in the prescribed application form (specimen template for Research Associate / JRF / SRF / Technical Staff) for the post of JRF.
Paste a recent passport size colour photograph in the space given on the form.
Scan the duly filled application together with the relevant supporting documents.
Write the subject as "JRF - ISRO-RESPOND Programme".
Make sure the application is submitted by 30.11.2026 at 5 P.M.
Attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate.
Photo copies of qualifying degree certificates and mark sheets/grade cards showing the percentage of marks or CGPA from HSC onwards (self-attested copies).
GATE and NET score details (subject and year), work experience and previous research work and publications, with copies of published or unpublished work, if any.
Proof of past study as a sponsored candidate, or other contractual obligation, if any.
List of enclosures, signed declaration and reference details as asked in the form.
The form also asks for the advertisement number with date, the project title and the post applied for. Experience, including research, industrial field and others, is to be shown.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Application should be furnished only in the prescribed format. The form carries a declaration that the applicant has no relative among the Faculty and Staff of NIT, Tiruchy. The declaration says that information found untrue can lead to forfeiture of the seat/appointment and legal action. If admitted, the applicant agrees to abide by the rules and regulations of the Institute and the project associated with it.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice prints one number, 01, for the combined JRF / PA-I position and gives no category-wise break-up.

rows.pay: JRF: 37,000+20% HRA (two years), valid GATE/NET score; PA-I: 31000+20% HRA (Two years), no GATE/NET score

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. Candidates must make sure they are eligible for the position they intend to apply for before appearing for the interview. Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++ and MATLAB for algorithm development, simulation and implementation. Good knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML) and deep learning algorithms. Fundamental knowledge of radar systems, radar signal processing, target detection, tracking and data association techniques. Good understanding of Digital Signal Processing (DSP), adaptive signal processing and statistical signal processing. Strong fundamentals in linear algebra, probability, statistics, optimization and numerical methods. Knowledge of multi-target tracking algorithms, Kalman filtering, state estimation and data association techniques. Ability to develop, simulate, analyze and validate AI-based algorithms using MATLAB and Python. Basic knowledge of radar resource management, intelligent scheduling and optimization techniques. The age of the applicant should be less than 35 years as on the closing date of application. Candidates belonging to OBC and SC / ST are eligible for normal relaxation of 3 and 5 years respectively.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E/B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering with minimum 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA from a recognized University/Institute with a qualified GATE score obtained in the last four years from the closing date of application, OR M.E/M.Tech in Communication Systems / Signal Processing or other specialization in ECE selected through GATE with 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA.

B.E/B.Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering with minimum 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA from a recognized University, OR M.E/M.Tech in Communication Systems / Signal Processing or any other specialization in ECE with 65% marks or 6.5 CGPA.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The duration is 2 years, with extension based on performance review every 12 months. The selected Junior Research Fellow will be permitted to register for the PhD/MS-PhD Programme as per NITT rules and regulations.
